text.7:8: The weighing on that day is the true (weighing). As for those whose scale is heavy, they are the successful.
text.18:105: Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him. Therefor their works are vain, and on the Day of Resurrection We assign no weight to them.
text.55:9: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
